rationale: The fix widens the pre-existing `except BadAPIRequestError` clause to also catch ValueError from empty API responses; the commit only added the unique_id removal block, which the fix does not touch.

The fix adds a call to a new library function close_stale_connections after the device lookup and bumps PySwitchbot; it is not clear whether stale connections are a gap in the commit's get_device fallback or an older, separate issue (#77630) that the PR itself is unsure about.

The real defect the fix repairs is the editable-install package name check ("lightning-app") from another commit; the commit's version log lines are only swapped from logger.info to print as a workaround, and that is not a functional defect in them.

The fix adds an experimental all-silo model category and replaces filtered_names with an unfiltered to_name_pairs as part of that new feature, not to correct the commit's renamed silo_limit attribute check.

The fix drops the obsolete --force flag from the self-upgrade hint messages; the flag came from older text the commit kept, and the bundle does not show whether the option was already removed when the commit edited these lines, so this is a stale message rather than a clear functional defect.

The fix commit is described as 'Optimized handling None values': it extends the early return to None (str(None) did not crash), which is an optimisation and not a repair of the commit's empty-string guard.

The commit only refactored existing FK-index logic into _create_missing_fk_index; the fix repairs a pre-existing gap (remove_constraint/remove_index on FKs not handled) and generalises the helper for expressions, so the reformatted lines change for the new use, not because they were wrong.

The commit runs the shell builtin `command -v` through subprocess without a shell and catches only FileNotFoundError, so on some non-SLURM platforms it raises a PermissionError; the fix replaces it with shutil.which.

The commit changed the editable-install check to look for a "lightning-app" egg-info that does not exist in the e2e install, so the function returned early and the PR's code was never packaged; the fix restores a package_name parameter that defaults to "lightning".

The commit builds category codes with np.arange(..., dtype=np.int8), which overflows when there are more than 127 categories and corrupts the category ordering; the fix drops the int8 dtype (the rest of its patch to this file is cleanup).
The commit's movflags 'frag_keyframe' produced fragmented mp4s without an empty moov atom that some players fail to play back; the fix changes that same option to 'frag_keyframe+empty_moov'.
The fix adds a new 10Hz inactive send rate to reduce LKAS faults caused by lag; the commit's camera-counter initialisation condition is only moved into an init_lka_counter variable, not corrected.

The fix adds a `last_org is not None` guard before features.has as a side effect of stricter test-side parameter validation; the bundle does not show whether calling features.has with a None organisation actually misbehaves in production.

The fix adds tags[transaction] to the commit's where-clause allowlist, but this looks tied to the fix's other-file change that starts filtering on the transformed transaction tag, so it is unclear whether the commit's allowlist was wrong for the queries that existed then.

The commit set bs = len(dataset) for every dataset, so for LoadImages the batch size became the number of files (breaking batch-dependent setup such as TensorRT warmup); the fix restores bs = 1 except for streams.
